AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#342 @ 56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/1

Job AUD-SOL-SH-118, agent 118. Independent T4 payment-contract, consent, and piece-boundary audit; no candidate runtime edits.

## Prior disposition and evidence reuse (G09)

Sol B-342-2 and Sol C-342-1 are closed: the complete/closed/refunded-review replies have distinct copy and machine actions, and the diagnostic canary is removed; the historical mapper probes now pass. ([Prior verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/342#issuecomment-5976926407), [independent exact-runtime replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220350807))

The seven wallet/config/API/appearance files remain byte-identical to original Sol-approved `78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1`; their unchanged evidence applies, while all ten piece files, all fix-round runtime lines, and consumer boundaries were read independently. Original B-334-3/4 and C-334-3 controls still execute over the #343 tree containing this exact #342 parent; reuse does not cover either counterexample below. ([Original Sol approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [exact candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1), [120-test recurring/boundary replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37219714087))

## B-342-1 — partly repaired: a lost HTTP response still becomes proof of no charge

**File:line:** `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:789–790` and offline copy `:456–457`. The repaired coded/unknown-HTTP branches are neutral, but any error without `response.status` immediately says “This phone is offline, so the payment did not start and nothing was charged”; a transport timeout is neither an offline diagnosis nor proof about the prior same-key attempt. ([Exact mapper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L789-L792), [actual HTTP timeout/interceptor](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1/src/services/api.ts#L98-L100))

**Executed counterexample:** the native one-time confirmation loses its answer, canonical purchases remain unreadable/not visible, and the same-key payment-intent retry times out without an HTTP response; the real hook replaces outcome-unknown copy with the categorical no-charge sentence. Both payment-intent/subscription-intent mapper probes also fail, while the missing-production-route and historical coded controls pass. ([Real-hook failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220350184/job/111489249671), [two mapper failures / 36 passing controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220350807/job/111489251167))

**Minimal fix rule:** uncoded transport failures must preserve outcome uncertainty, the outstanding key, a short reference, and support/plan-reconciliation guidance; only a genuinely proven pre-send refusal may claim no charge. Replay the no-response tests through the real hook, not only coded HTTP envelopes.

## B-342-3 — newly wired consent formatting misstates a permitted JPY charge by 100×

**File:line:** new `src/lib/planTerms.ts:150–151,155–161,215–221,224–226`, delegating to inherited `src/utils/currency.ts:13–19`. A package with `amount_cents:4900,currency:'jpy'` is accepted by the adapter and shown as 49 yen in the plan price/CTA, but the one-time backend forwards `amount:4900,currency:'jpy'` unchanged to Stripe, whose minor-unit contract charges 4900 yen; the backend permits three-letter currencies rather than enforcing USD-only. ([New formatting boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1/src/lib/planTerms.ts#L150-L161), [inherited unconditional division](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/56f281ad3aa977882c962a6591d3594899cdd5a1/src/utils/currency.ts#L8-L21), [backend accepted currency](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/76aa84b8350ea56e8dac65757efe6ebac6579569/src/packages/packages.service.ts#L898-L903), [actual charge parameters](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f80f0088c98cd078cffa5dd217a8fdc84ad631b2/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts#L708-L712), [Stripe presentment minor units](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies))

**Executed counterexample:** the actual adapter plus `money` returns numeric **49**, expected **4900**, for JPY; the USD control passes. The lane also includes an exploratory KWD-formatting failure, which is not relied on as proof of supported Stripe presentment. ([Exact-runtime currency probe: 2 failures / 1 control pass](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220824000/job/111490624818))

**Minimal fix rule:** format supported presentment minor units using the currency's applicable exponent, with no FX/settlement conversion; preserve exact integer request amounts and require terms/CTA/first-charge tests for USD plus a supported zero-decimal currency. The helper itself is inherited, but this new money-consent consumer is unsafe with its unconditional cent assumption, so this is B, not an unrelated utility cleanup.

## Follow-up C (freeze)

**C-342-1 (Opus, inherited; distinct from the now-closed Sol diagnostic finding):** `src/lib/planTerms.ts:90–93` treats a legacy one-time row with a zero recurring companion as renewing, causing an unbuyable subscription-route loop; new-row validation prevents this legacy shape, and the builder's sole still-red historical probe is explicitly held under the freeze. Fix rule: require `recurringAmount > 0` in `isCombo`, in a follow-up owned by the operator. ([Prior classification/counterexample](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/342#issuecomment-5977006434), [current deferred probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37219370245/job/111486403792))

## CI and landing boundary

Applicable exact-head Typecheck/lint/test and both CodeQL analyses are green; size remains **2,018 changed lines**, within the assessed 1,500–3,000 band, not a SIZE FAIL. ([Ordinary CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37219351230), [CodeQL](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37219351237), [fix-round size](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/342#issuecomment-5982491578))

The current production backend's missing subscription-intent route has a specific truthful coach-contact fallback, while recurring uncertain/setup/plan-change codes remain distinct; PAYMENT_SUCCESS_RETRY/PAYMENT_FAILURE_RETRY belong to webhook processing, not a client payment-completion contract. ([Production-fallback control](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220350807), [webhook-only retry construction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f80f0088c98cd078cffa5dd217a8fdc84ad631b2/src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts#L115-L130))

Land #342–#344 as one after dual exact-head approvals and final-main checks, retaining the native card-update composition gate; no native-device/provider or production acceptance is claimed. ([Stack landing condition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/342#issuecomment-5975774150), [original composition condition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092))
